subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core support a typed operator-controlled Control UI CSP/Permissions-Policy config surface, and which directives should be configurable?
rationale: The remaining request changes browser security boundaries and core config contract; code inspection can show the gap, but not the acceptable policy surface.

options.title: Approve narrow typed policy
options.body: Add directive-limited CSP and Permissions-Policy config under gateway.controlUi or gateway.http with strict validation, schema/help/docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Keep fixed headers
options.body: Document reverse proxy or same-origin plugin route patterns and do not add a core header-override surface.

options.title: Defer until custom UI API design
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work for a broader custom Control UI or plugin web-route contract.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow typed policy
recommendation.body: Add directive-limited CSP and Permissions-Policy config under gateway.controlUi or gateway.http with strict validation, schema/help/docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent and historical signal across Control UI CSP, Gateway hardening, and config policy surfaces.
